name: local.vrcavatartools.exporter
description: Exports a VRChat avatar (built like an upload: Modular Avatar / NDMF) as VRM 1.0 with lilToon converted to MToon, plus a <name>.vavmeta.json sidecar (Expression Menu and the Gesture / Action / FX animator with baked humanoid clips) for VRC Avatar Tools. Needs UniVRM 0.128-0.131 (com.vrmc.gltf + com.vrmc.vrm), installed separately from git.
